description.html: PRODUCT DETAILS STANDARD SIZE. Measure 3 9/16" x 5/16". Both parents and toddlers will love these crayon. Perfect birthday gifts, holiday presents, and Christmas gift. SAFE & NON TOXIC. Made from paraffin wax, these crayons come in assorted classic colors that bring drawings to life. Includes a storage box and helps develop fine motor skills during fun learning! UNLIMITED IMAGINATION. Explore colors, writing, and drawing. Perfect for students, teachers, artists, and anyone ready to create and dream. CREATIVE PROJECTS. These colorful art tools have the ability to unleash countless hours of self-expression and imaginative play. Make your project pop in bold, bright colors. FUN GAME. You can write letters, numbers, practice spelling with your little one, play a game of tic tac toe, or scribble and draw on coloring book. Crayons will add hours of creativity.

BAZIC Washable Products can wash away from skin and most washable clothing types. PRODUCT DETAILS SMOOTH GEL CRAYONS. Rainbow eye-catching bright color, buttery texture, brilliant colors, and superior blending help you create works of art with ease. IDEAL FOR BEGINNERS. Perfect for beginners artist to learn the basics of drawing, coloring, and blending! They’re great on textures, dark surfaces, glass, mirrors, paper, posters. TEACHERS & PARENTS APPROVED. Silky gel crayons are loved by children, students and adults because of their ease of use. It is a perfect gift for holiday. CONVENIENT STORAGE. Crayons are stored in a plastic sturdy storage case with individual spots to hold each crayon, so you can always keep them neatly organized and on the go. SAFE FOR KIDS. This crayon is non-toxic, acid-free, conforms to ASTM D-4236, and is great for ages 3+.
